messages:
release-manager: heads up: canary publish failing at artifact push step (multipart). deploybot auto-promo paused.

deploybot: job 'canary-push' failed run deploy/2026-03-21-114, status: error. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/8142 

ci-bot: upload log: "upload part 3/6 succeeded, finalizing manifest -> manifest digest mismatch: expected sha256:fff1a but registry reports sha256:ffb2b". Retries exhausted.

sam: is the builder producing a different tar order or metadata? we recently changed tar gzip flags.

lina: could be parallel chunk reassembly bug in our nginx-layered registry. infra-oncall any alerts?

infra-oncall: noticed object-store error spike 15:34 UTC, some PUTs returned 500 then recovered. likely corrupted multipart commit.

qa-bot: regression risk if we continue; last-known-good image: prod-2026-03-19-22. window closes in 18m.

release-manager: decision: pin to last-known-good to avoid breaking customers. open follow-up to hard-validate reupload + add server-side digest check on promote.

deploybot: applying pin -> channel canary pinned to prod-2026-03-19-22. Manual promote allowed for release-manager.

sam: i'll attempt a single-stream push in parallel and validate digest; won't block the window. if it matches, we can manual promote tonight.

lina: filing infra ticket #5042 to investigate multipart finalization race and to add an object-store reconciliation check.

release-manager: release notes line: "Canary promotion paused due to registry multipart commit digest mismatch; promotion pinned to last-known-good image. Teams reuploaded artifact and follow-up validation scheduled."

infra-oncall: scheduling 1h follow-up meeting to review object-store durable writes and add a pre-publish digest verification step in CI.

release-manager: thanks — closing thread for now, will reopen if manual promote occurs.
